items.title: Support validate storyId JSON alias without silent diagnostic fallback
items.context: Normalize validate args so storyId aliases story, conflict fails, and JSON body writes story test-evidence instead of silently becoming read-only diagnostic validate.
items.userSees: lattice validate {"storyId":"B-xxxx","json":true} 刷新对应 story 的 test-evidence；如果参数冲突会明确报错。

happy.desc: validate JSON body with storyId writes/refreshes test-evidence.json for that story.

edge.desc: validate --story continues to work and no-story validate remains diagnostic/read-only.

adversarial.desc: passing both story and a different storyId fails instead of choosing one silently.

verificationEvidence.note: validation-protocol smoke covers B-a30e storyId alias: JSON storyId validate writes story test-evidence instead of silently falling back to diagnostic validate.
same smoke asserts --story still writes evidence and no-story validate remains diagnostic/read-only without creating .koala state.
same smoke asserts conflicting story and storyId values reject explicitly before validation/persistence.

items.title: Render phase-aware scope freshness guidance
items.context: Change scope protection next-action so stale/missing review bindings still guide REVIEW gate, while TEST/DONE surfaces explain advisory vs blocking behavior accurately.
items.userSees: TEST 阶段不会再看到 before REVIEW→TEST 的误导提示；blocking scope failures still show hard recovery commands.

happy.desc: REVIEW stale/missing binding still instructs review_run_start before REVIEW→TEST.

edge.desc: TEST stale review binding renders as post-review advisory/delivery-review guidance, not REVIEW→TEST instruction.

adversarial.desc: path/semantic/guard fail remains blocking and is not softened by the new TEST advisory copy.

verificationEvidence.note: semantic scope guard smoke asserts REVIEW stale/missing binding still names review_run_start and REVIEW-to-TEST guidance.
same smoke asserts TEST stale/missing review binding renders post-review advisory copy and does not contain REVIEW-to-TEST guidance.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:semantic-scope-guard-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: semantic scope and flow stability smokes pass with path/semantic/guard fail still blocking and not softened by advisory copy.

items.title: Expose owner-lease takeover meta options in CLI help
items.context: Owner gate already consumes takeover/forceTakeover before schema validation; help should present these common owner recovery flags for owner-gated commands.
items.userSees: story_advance/validate/checklist_update help shows --takeover and --forceTakeover with stale-vs-active lease semantics.

happy.desc: owner-gated command help includes takeover and forceTakeover guidance.

edge.desc: read-only command help does not imply takeover is needed.

adversarial.desc: help change does not alter owner gate behavior; active takeover still requires forceTakeover and logs event.

verificationEvidence.note: command ownership contract asserts owner-gated command help exposes --takeover and --forceTakeover guidance, including validate story-target note.
same contract asserts readOnly, reviewerWrite, and mainSharedMutating commands do not advertise takeover recovery.
story-owner-lease smoke confirms active foreign lease still requires --forceTakeover, stale takeover semantics and audit events remain intact.

items.title: Clarify scope-warning recovery path after REVIEW
items.context: Scope warnings should distinguish advisory shadow warnings from blocking scope failures and point to acknowledge, rollback DEV, or delivery reviewer verification as appropriate.
items.userSees: scope warnings explain whether they block and what exact command/path to use next, reducing false alarm during TEST/DONE.

happy.desc: scope warning output mentions advisory/not blocking when mode is shadow/warn.

edge.desc: later-phase necessary out-of-scope expansion points to scope_contract_acknowledge or rollback DEV.

adversarial.desc: scope_contract_set phase limits remain unchanged and warnings do not become silent pass.

verificationEvidence.note: scope-contract smoke asserts shadow/warn transition output says advisory, not blocking and names scope_contract_acknowledge recovery.
same smoke asserts TEST-phase warnings point to rolling back to DEV to acknowledge or delivery reviewer verification.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract && npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: command ownership and flow stability smokes pass, confirming scope command phase policy remains unchanged and warnings are not silent pass.
